Zamari Surfaces

A catalog and quote-request website for a bathroom & kitchen fixtures studio — collections, finish customizer, and a WhatsApp quote flow.

Nuxt 3Vue 3Tailwind CSSTypeScript

Overview

Zamari Surfaces is a marketing and catalog site for a studio selling bathroom and kitchen fixtures — sinks, faucets, and natural stone surfaces (granite, quartz, marble). The site’s job is simple and hard: make a premium catalog feel tangible on a phone, and turn interest into quote requests.

Solution

A Nuxt 3 single-page experience built from focused, reusable sections — hero, collections, a finish customizer for visualizing materials, assurance and reviews sections, and a quote form with a sticky bottom bar on mobile so the call-to-action is never more than a thumb away.

Architecture

  • Component-per-section design. Each storefront section is a self-contained Vue component, making the page easy to reorder, A/B, and extend without touching global state.
  • Conversion-first layout. The quote funnel is persistent (sticky mobile bar, repeated CTAs) and low-friction — a visitor is never more than one tap from requesting a quote.
  • Config-driven content. Product and collection data live in composables, so catalog updates don’t require template surgery.

Lessons Learned

For local commerce, the website is a salesperson that works nights and weekends. Every section either builds trust (reviews, assurance) or lowers the cost of asking for a quote — anything else is decoration.
